ideas.title: FastAPI Rejects a JSON Request with 422 Because the Pydantic Model Does Not Match the Payload
ideas.description: Fix a FastAPI validation error caused by field names, types, or nesting that do not match the incoming JSON body.
ideas.angle: Explain how FastAPI uses Pydantic to validate request bodies before the handler runs. Show how mismatched field names, missing nesting, optional types, and strict models produce a 422 response, then demonstrate the exact model and payload shape that must line up.

ideas.title: Nginx Closes a WebSocket Connection After the Upgrade Because the Timeout Is Too Low
ideas.description: Fix an Nginx reverse proxy that accepts a WebSocket upgrade but drops the socket during idle periods.
ideas.angle: Explain that a successful upgrade only establishes the tunnel; Nginx can still close it with proxy read and send timeouts. Show the required websocket proxy headers and the timeout settings that keep the connection open for idle traffic.

drafted.title: Cargo Builds a Rust CLI but the Installed Command Never Appears in PATH
drafted.description: Fix a Rust package that compiles but does not install a runnable binary because the crate metadata is incomplete.
drafted.angle: Cover how Cargo decides whether a package exposes a binary and where it places the executable during `cargo install`. Explain the role of `[[bin]]`, `src/main.rs`, and package naming, then show how to make the command discoverable in PATH after installation.
